nfl.label: week 7
nfl.injuries: midweek: practice reports plus ESPN's latest injury news for 25 of 28 teams; final statuses come with Friday's report (Saturday morning in Melbourne)
nfl.early_text: Player ratings still lean on last season for the first few weeks, so treat big disagreements with the bookies with extra care.
nfl.subtitle: Win chances and minimum prices from player ratings, unit matchups, injuries, rest, travel and weather, blended with the current betting price (90% stats this week). The stats-only pick is shown on every game.
nfl.foot_note: Win % = the stats model blended with the current moneyline (DraftKings via ESPN, else the nflverse listed line): 90% stats in weeks 1-9 and the playoffs, chosen for the most units in the 2020-25 backtest (head-to-head and lines with a 7%+ edge made about +24 units a season in weeks 1-9 against +16 at the old 60%), and 0% from week 10, where every stats weight lost money (rested starters, late injury news): from week 10 the board shows the price, so expect almost no value bets. NFL totals made about +7 units a season in weeks 1-9 and lost a little from week 10. The reasons, injuries and "stats only" line on each game are the stats model by itself. Lines and totals here use NFL key numbers: margins of 3, 7, 10 and 14 and totals like 37, 41, 44 and 51 come up more often, and the push chances on those numbers are fitted from past games. Underdog rule: bet the model's pick only when it is priced 2.00 to 2.60. It is the best backtested spot so far but unproven going forward.
